scope: Adapted public visual assets in a fictional district; not surveyed Chinese buildings, verified local vegetation species, or geometry reconstructed from generated images.
preparation: Downloaded public 1k glTF assets with verified upstream MD5 hashes. Blender 5.1.2: selected facade modules, dissolved coplanar wall subdivisions, reduced vegetation geometry, removed leaf faces for a separate winter variant. Exported self-contained GLB. At runtime, window/wall modules are instanced onto the existing twelve building IDs; local CC0 concrete materials replace source plaster to match the city palette. Authored balcony rails and roof services retained. No remote GPU reconstruction.
